result.rationale: Mild lateral ankle sprain with negative bony tenderness findings (Ottawa-type criteria negative for malleolar and midfoot tenderness), no deformity, wound, or numbness. Ability to bear weight is untested; advise RICE, OTC analgesia, then cautiously try 4 steps—if unable to bear weight or pain/swelling worsens over 48–72 hours, escalate to clinician for evaluation/imaging.
